### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s).

**13** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/declarative-endpoints.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions), time_relative (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/automation/workflows.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/concepts/architecture.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/common-patterns.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions), time_relative (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via time_relative (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via record_change (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via time_relative (literal, a string literal in validateFlowExpressions))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **250** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b2ee3a5ae6fd526a113566c414de6564f7ea2d12` — the merge of head `254d40cb40233500bc47152a1e91da62a451a324` into base `482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b2ee3a5ae6fd526a113566c414de6564f7ea2d12 && git checkout b2ee3a5ae6fd526a113566c414de6564f7ea2d12
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973 254d40cb40233500bc47152a1e91da62a451a324 && git checkout -B drift-repro 482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973 && git merge --no-ff 254d40cb40233500bc47152a1e91da62a451a324

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 482afcc4df4774843b3ba863a8f7ad3eaffbd973` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:作者把多值字段(多选、标签、`multiple: true` 字段)和单个值比较相等时,拒绝提示里给出的改写现在每个位置都能直接用。共享规则条件里也能生效;改写整体加了括号,不会被前面的条件拆开。由接口、定时或无触发方式启动的流程里,这种写法不再被误拒。
- 为什么做:卡 #36167 的最后一项,对应 #36207 合并时还没处理的四条复审发现(r05 S1、S2、S4 / r06 N1、S1)。
- 出错会怎样:作者最多看到另一种改写建议,或某个流程条件不再被拦下;已存储的数据不受影响,可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。非受管;在席位的契约档 L2(claim 7076520830)PASS 之后入队。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36340` 只标记了一项:`changeset`,说 `@objectstack/mcp` 被改了却没有 changeset。我读过后撤销这一项:mcp 里只改了一个测试文件(`src/mcp-validate-expression.list-equality-36167.test.ts`),而 `packages/mcp/package.json` 的 `files` 只有 `dist`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`,测试文件不会发出去。真正改了源码的四个包(formula、lint、service-automation、spec)都在 changeset 头里,都是 `minor`,与 `Metadata-protocol: added` 相符。其余 12 项都是 ok;draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36167`,建造器一半(#36185)和校验器一半(#36207)已合并,剩下的跟进各有卡(#36217、#36218、#36219,三张均 open),所以 `Fixes` 成立。11 个文件 +536 −64;`check-governed-merges` NOT governed,600 行。
- 声明:`Clause-②: yes (widening)` 有两处放宽:一是新增可选键 `ExprSchemaHint.filterCompiled`;二是 API、定时、无触发流程的条件不再被拒。我核过 diff,没有一处让拒绝变多:`checkListEquality` 只多了一个提前返回,其余改动只改改写文本。`Skills-docs: follow-up #36217` 属实。
- 逐句核:changeset 每个位置的 FROM/TO 写法都和 `listMembershipRewrite` 的三条分支一字不差。`registerFlow` 的说法也对:`runBindsTypedRow` 只是搬到了 hint 前面,表达式没变,在记录触发和时间相对扫描上带 `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'`。semantic 条目 `18.cel-list-equality-refused` 的 surface 和 replacement 也与代码相符。
- 测试证据:每一种改写都是从拒绝提示本身取出来再实际运行的。CEL 读法在 `[a,b]`/`[b]`/`[]`/`null`/缺键和 `previous = null` 上跑过,并放进 `&&`/`||` 里验证括号;过滤器写法用 `compileCelToFilter` 降级,再用 `matchesFilterCondition` 匹配。对照用例:API、定时、无触发三种流程不出 list-equality;CEL `in` 写法在共享规则上仍会被判 `sharing-rule-unlowerable-condition`。七处消融各自让对应的钉变红,恢复后 blob 等于 HEAD。dev 还修了两个从没真正跑到断言的 fixture(共享规则用了 spec 里不存在的 `role` 接收方;API 流程缺 hook secret),正文写明了修了什么、为什么。driver-sql 那一段只引用了现有钉,没有在本 PR 实跑,正文如实写明。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `254d40cb`:60 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check 均 success。本地 `dispatch-gates --ran` 96 族全部跑完,无 NOT-MEASURED。
- 接受的偏差(nit):`validate-expressions.ts` 共享规则那一处调用为了传 `filterCompiled`,连写了九个位置参数 `undefined`,读起来费劲,不改本 head。
- 范围外去向:#36217(skills 文本)动笔时要教本 PR 的分位置写法:CEL 读法用 `has()` 守卫,共享规则用 `.contains(…)`,整体加括号。请席位在 #36217 上记一行指针,指向本 PR。
- 落地条款:非受管,600 行 ≤ 3000。席位契约档 L2 PASS 在案、无未闭 must-fix/should-fix ⇒ ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `254d40cb40233500bc47152a1e91da62a451a324`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.cel-list-equality-refused.ts + packages/formula/src/validate.ts, packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts

Inputs read: card #36167 (body and all 14 comments), PR #36340 (body, both comments, 11-file list), the net diff against `main` (merge-base `2b570445`), and the 73 check-runs on this head: every one `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. The rest of the diff (four test files, the changeset body as prose) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface, added: optional key `ExprSchemaHint.filterCompiled` on the published `@objectstack/formula` type. Additive; absent means the CEL spelling, so every existing caller is unchanged. Right.
- Accept set, widened: `checkListEquality` returns before any verdict at an explicit `scope: 'flattened'` site unless `faultOutcome` is `'run-fails'`. Flow conditions on API, scheduled, trigger-less flows and on a sweep of another object are accepted again, bare and `record.`; so is a non-gate node `config.condition` in the lint, which is handed no outcome. Right: the lint ledger (`faultOutcomeOf`) declares `run-fails` only where a row of the typed object is bound.
- Accept set, narrowed: nothing. The sharing rule `condition` was already judged through the lint `check` with `multiValueFields`; only the message and `params.rewrite` change there. The previously prescribed spelling stays accepted at every site. Right.
- Refusal payload: `ExpressionRefusalParams['list-equality'].rewrite` changes text (parenthesised, per-site). Same key set, same code. A consumer pinning the old string sees new text; not a shape change. Right.
- `registerFlow` advisory pass: now hands `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'` on the flows `runBindsTypedRow` names. Read in `validateFlowExpressions`: the hinted pass feeds `logger.warn` only, and `valueEnvelopeFieldTypes` reads `schemaHint.fieldTypes` alone, so nothing thrown or stored moves. Right.
- Semantic entry `cel-list-equality-refused`: surface and replacement prose updated, same `id`. Right.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds on the tree: one optional public key added, one refusal withdrawn, no refusal added. The changeset carries the same three declaration lines as the PR body and the amended claim 7076040422. `minor` on `@objectstack/formula` (new public key) and `@objectstack/lint` (accept set widened, prescription changed) matches what is published. `minor` on `@objectstack/service-automation` (log wording and the advisory's reach) and `@objectstack/spec` (entry prose) is at or above what the diff publishes; over-declaring is not an error. `@objectstack/mcp` is rightly absent: only a test file moves there. `Check Changeset` (both runs) and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` concluded `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 7076502400: `open_questions` is empty. The earlier open question (7075362046: keep `filterCompiled` as a public key, A, or rewrite the prescription locally in the lint, B) is answered A on the merits, not only by the claim: the refusal's `params.rewrite` and its message are built in the validator, so B would leave the params carrying a spelling that does not lower while the lint sentence said another.
- Deviation, claim declared `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed`, PR declares `yes (widening)` / `added`: the tree agrees with the PR (①), and the seat's amended claim agrees.
- Deviation, two fixtures repaired at this head (lint sharing rule fixture, service-automation API flow control): test files, outside ④; `Test Core` 10/10 concluded `success` on this head.
- Flag, driver-sql leg cited not run: read `JSON_COLUMN_INCOMPATIBLE_OPERATORS` (`packages/core`): `$eq` / `$ne` / `$in` are refused on a multi-value column and `$contains` / `$notContains` are deliberately absent, documented there as the only membership spelling. The citation holds.
- Flag, a decision or other non-gate node `config.condition` gets no verdict in the lint: consistent with the ledger row (inert, `flow-inert-node-condition`). Accepted.
- SQL push-down: no id materialisation and no in-app join is added. The sharing-site prescription moves from a form the filter compiler refuses to one that lowers to `$contains`, which is push-down gained.
- Out-of-scope note in the report (docs-drift lists 13 pages by trigger-kind literals): none of those anchors is the list-equality text; skills text is carried by #36217.

### ④ Design judgment

Hits file, `18.cel-list-equality-refused.ts`, against the code it describes and its first consumer (the validator's refusal):

- Surface: the added "sharing rule condition" and "flow whose run binds a row of that object: a record-triggered flow, or a time-relative sweep of it" match `check(..., true)` at the sharing site and the early return in `checkListEquality`. The "Not the shape" list matches the three exits (comprehension binding, `flowVariables`, no proven row).
- Replacement: the three spellings match `listMembershipRewrite` arm for arm. Tried to break each: the `has()` conjunction is the repo's own stated guard for a sparse binding (`validate-null-guards.ts` ledger, action `visible` / `disabled` row) and is harmless on a total one; the bare form has no `has()` because the macro takes no bare name; the filter form uses the one operator the JSON-column gate leaves open. No other filter-compiled site reaches this validator with a typed object (RLS predicates are judged by their own gates; the MCP site map has no sharing site), so no site is left with a prescription that fails where it is read.

Implementing files, sentence by sentence:

- `validate.ts`, `listMembershipRewrite` / `listEqualityRefusal`: agrees with the docblocks and the entry. `filterCompiled` with a bare read falls through to the bare arm, which cannot occur at a `record` site. Number and boolean operands are quoted as text; read `storedArrayHasMember`, which matches a stored JSON number by its text.
- `expression-refusal.ts`: the `list-equality` params docblock matches what `listEqualityRefusal` emits.
- `validate-expressions.ts`: the new trailing `check` parameter is spread only when true; the one caller is the sharing rule. Agrees.
- `flow-registration-checks.ts`: `runBindsTypedRow` is the existing expression moved above the hint, unedited; the hint takes `run-fails` on exactly those flows.

S1 (should-fix) — `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, the new early return tests `schema?.scope === 'flattened'`, while the published `scope` docblock names `'flattened'` the default and the type pass in the same function reads an absent `scope` as flattened (the `else` of `schema?.scope === 'record'`). A hint that omits `scope` therefore still has `record.f == 'a'` refused with no `run-fails` proof, on any flow, which is the false refusal this PR removes, and the new `multiValueFields` sentence "At a flattened site with no proven row, nothing is judged" is untrue for that hint. Measured reach in this repo: none; every producer (lint `check`, MCP site map, `registerFlow`, the scenario scorer, Studio `lintCelPredicate`) passes `scope` explicitly, so only an outside caller of the published validator meets it. Non-blocking, and it can be carried on a follow-up card (#36218 already holds this PR family's review follow-ups): test `scope !== 'record'` there and at `bareSubjects`, with one pin for the absent-scope hint.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; left as follow-up, not fixed on this head):

- N1 — `checkListEquality` docblock still opens with "The prescription is membership, in the null-guarded spelling the Studio condition builder writes: `S != null && V in S`", which the paragraph added below it and `listMembershipRewrite` now contradict for a `record.` read.
- N2 — the changeset says `registerFlow`'s logged type-mismatch lines "now use the wording `os validate` prints". Not on a time-relative sweep (the pass hands no `timeRelativeSweep`, so the logged line names a firing write the sweep does not have) nor where a flow variable or an open binder shadows the name (no `flowVariables` / `bareNamesUnproven`, already #36218). Log text only.
- N3 — the entry's surface lists an action's `visible` / `disabled` and omits `pressed`, which the lint judges; its "Not the shape" list omits the `bareNamesUnproven` exit and the sweep of another object; the text operand rule (`contains("3")`) is in the changeset but not the entry.
- N4 — a `uint` literal (`3u`) would be quoted as `"3u"` at the filter site and match nothing; a field name that is not a CEL identifier (`record['a-b']`) renders `has(record.a-b)`. Both need a list field compared with an unusual literal or name; the second predates this PR.

Escalations for the seat (outside this diff, not graded here):

- The merged Studio builder half (#36185) writes `S != null && V in S` for a list subject; this PR's own measurement says that form faults on a sparse action row and on a null `previous`. Builder and validator now prescribe different spellings for the same site. No carrier is named on the card.
- The relationship-hop gap from 7073202453 (`record.account.labels == 'a'` judged at no door) was left "for the seat to file"; no card number appears in the card thread.
- #36217 (skills text) must teach three per-site spellings, not one.
- The PR says `Fixes #36167`: merging closes the card with #36217, #36218 and #36219 open, and with S1 if it is carried.
- 7075362046 reads the merged #36207 as owing `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; bookkeeping on a merged PR, the seat's call.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36167-list-equality-followup`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC`

**VERDICT: PASS**
